name: print-social-pelifilms-streaming-membership-posts-with-glass-panels
title: Pelifilms streaming membership pack with teal frosted-glass panels over movie-night photos
whatItIs: Five posts showing friends watching TV in a dark room, with dark teal frosted-glass panels carrying 'Enjoy our free trial month' and 'Discover our new rates' in white, a cyan 'Subscribe now' pill and social icons.
whatItMeans: Cosy and cinematic; frosted glass lets the living-room scene show through like a screen overlay.
techniques: Overlay a frosted-glass panel on moody photos.
Keep the palette dark with one cyan CTA.
Show the product in use, not the product itself.

vocabulary.definition: A photo showing people using a product naturally.
